notes.title: Devlog #1: What’s my motivation?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350016/fc535044aa3fc890890a356c90964a7f6ee67118.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hello, drama lovers![/h2]

Welcome to the jung- wait, wrong card, welcome to June! Hope you’ve been having a lovely, drama-free, unlike Perseverance, time since we last talked. [b]Thank you for all the wishlists and warm comments that you sent our way[/b], we appreciate hearing your impressions, feedback, and juicy gossip as much as ever so keep them coming! Now, the devlog…

[h2]JACK AND KAREN: WHAT MOTIVATES THEM?[/h2]

[b]If you've met Jack and Karen, you know that they are two very different people.[/b]
Jack is a guy who has always prioritized family and peace of mind, but unfortunately for him, those don't always go hand in hand. His ambition has always been for his daughter, Hope, to have a better life in Grey Ville than he did. Sadly, his priorities often shift from this noble pursuit and get drowned in a bottle. Which way will the pendulum swing when it matters the most?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350016/7695765d3237ca680faec9e699ce8b75795c5402.jpg[/img]

[b]Karen, on the other hand, is the loner type.[/b] Raised in an orphanage, she got another shot at life by working for an agency and doing their dirty work. It wasn’t a great life but it… worked, she was protected. Once she failed at her task, however, the demons of her past came back with a vengeance, and are here to shape her future. Will she keep running from them or confront them?

[h2]TOOLS OF THE TRADE[/h2]

Aside from both being complex, flawed human beings, there’s another thing our characters have in common. They have unique sets of experiences that prepared them for a dangerous situation, [b]like the one they find themselves in at the start of Part 3.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350016/3ea6072b954b9195bc6d9de3d874e2f1a8c80de3.jpg[/img]

Jack is a great hunter, he knows how to track prey and is comfortable with a gun, something that will no doubt be a crucial advantage in the coming apocalypse. His father taught him how to live in the woods, find food, water, shelter, etc. [b]Will his survival skills allow him to save his family? Or will he put his own safety above others?[/b]

Karen is a trained killer, a specialist. She knows how to handle a gun, and she's well versed in martial arts. Her mentor, Dave, has made sure she's ready for anything. [b]That's right, anything, but does that include the apocalypse?[/b]

[h2]THE CHOICE IS YOURS[/h2]

It's up to you what path Jack will take. Will he take care of his family, will he fight for himself, or will he drown his sorrows and torments in alcohol? And will Karen overcome her demons and focus on who she is and what she's learned - to help herself and who knows maybe others survive? And at what cost… Whatever your choice, always remember that it’s you who will have to live with the consequences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42350016/8ad6e1f2d05faf7183648271721298c1327278ab.jpg[/img]

Alright, that’s it for now, drama lovers! [b]Make sure to tap that Wishlist button to never miss any new tea from us and to let us know in the comments who you’re playing as![/b] If you’d like to talk about the game and argue about which character is better, hop on Feardemic Discord and join the conversation there!

[b]Missed the opportunity to play the demo? No time for it? Watch our stream and see what's comin'![/b]

[b]Catch you next time, Fearfolks![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514460/Perseverance_Part_3/

notes.title: NextFest stream coming June 13 // Check out the demo!
notes.content:
Hello, drama lovers!

The clock struck NextFest o’clock, and we almost spilled our tea. Almost! But we’re here with it now so fret not. We figured that we’re due a catch-up and since the festivities are coming, it was a perfect opportunity for us to schedule a stream. That’s right, a stream on Steam, next week at NextFest. Rolls off the tongue, right? Anyway, the stream will take place on June 13, and we really hope you’ll come. We can’t promise biscuits for everyone but there will undoubtedly be enough drama to fill a stadium.

It’s also fortunate timing for another reason, since the Perseverance: Part 3 demo will be participating in NextFest, you all can play along with the stream, and see what happens if you choose differently than us. Now that’s exciting, isn’t it? Just… make sure that you can live with the consequences.

Alright, that was just a short update, we’ll catch you on June 13, mark the date!

Stay fierce, Fearfolks!

notes.title: A welcome, a trailer, and a demo - Perseverence Part 3
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/231783b2686b111d50fc07b4e720f6e466a7d14b.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, drama lovers![/h2]

Hope you’re having a lovely May, we certainly are. We had just released [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1367460/Perseverance_Part_2/]Part 2 of Perseverance[/url] last month and made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/854870/Perseverance_Part_1/]Part 1 free to play[/url], [b]and we’re already back with more because we just couldn’t wait to share it with you![/b] As you may already know if you’ve watched [b]Feardemic’s Fear Fest[/b], we’ve been working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514460/Perseverance_Part_3/]Perseverance: Part 3[/url], and we’re finally ready to spill more tea about what’s next for Jack and Karen. 

As you may have gathered, in this one both of the main characters from the previous entries make a comeback, but, [b]here’s the twist[/b], for the first time, you get to choose which one of them you'd like to experience the story as. It’s also a culmination of a lot of work on this and previous games, so we’re really proud of what we’ve accomplished.

[b]You can read all the deets on the Perseverance: Part 3 Steam Store page or you can watch this brand new Reveal Trailer[/b] we’ve prepared just for this occasion. We’re super thrilled to share this with you, so let us know your thoughts in the comments because we love hearing from you and it gives us the motivation to keep going, and your feedback helps us create a better game. Now, without further ado, the Reveal Trailer for Perseverance: Part 3:

[previewyoutube=vLnJUUWTQ40;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Excited? Hungry for more? Well, we’ve got you covered[/b]. If you simply can’t wait to see what’s coming in the Perseverance series, you can check out the [b]FREE demo[/b] that we have just released. Simply click the Play Game button on the Perseverance: Part 3 Store Page and get right back to Grey Ville for your scheduled drama injection. [b]Oh, and while you’re on that page, don’t forget to add Part 3 to your Wishlist, to make sure you’ll never miss an update or any juicy gossip:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514460/Perseverance_Part_3/

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29115981/1482a96bd7d90d54abbf6625a6ad3b4ab43ccb7a.jpg[/img]

Speaking of gossip, let us know in the comments and on Twitter, whether you’re [b]#TeamJack[/b] or [b]#TeamKaren[/b], we’re excited to hear who you’ll be playing as! Make sure to tag [b]@feardemic[/b] and [b]@TitaniteNovels[/b] as well so we can see your tweets more easily. If you’d like to talk about the game and argue about which character is better, make sure to hop on [url=https://discord.gg/yTaJkdDKtY]Feardemic Discord[/url] and join the conversation there!


[b]Catch you next time, Fearfolks![/b]
